Name: Rolling Hills Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS]another farm map to celebrate 1.4 finally being released on android yayy[/font]

[font=Trebuchet MS]if you like my mods, please consider [/font][url=http://buymeacoffee.com/daisyniko]leaving a tip[/url]﻿ if you've got extra cash to throw at a broke university student who's addicted to stardew valley


[b]features[/b]

▹ replaces forest farm by default (configurable)
▹ renewable hardwood, forage, and fishing (only when replacing forest farm)
▹ slightly bigger farm cave with minecart link (optional)
▹ a secret hidden cave somewhere (requires farm cave enabled)
▹ invisible barriers in animal pens
▹ various shortcuts around the place
▹ troughs act as water sources


[b]requirements[/b]

▹ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]
▹ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]
▹ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]


[b]installation[/b]

[font=Arial]1. download all required mods[/font]
2. extract mod folder to Stardew Valley/Mods
3. run the game with SMAPI and start a new save


[b]config options[/b]
[i]run the game once with the mod installed to generate config.json file[/i]

▹ FarmToReplace: Standard, Forest, Riverland, Hilltop, or Wilderness
▹ EnableFarmCave: true or false


[font=Trebuchet MS]hope you enjoy x [/font]
